verdict.rationale: Fivetran natively supports scheduled recurring syncs (down to 1-minute intervals) and can auto-trigger transformations after each sync or on a custom schedule via dbt/Coalesce orchestration, covering the core 'recurring jobs' need for a data-pipeline product. missing for 10: evidence of general-purpose workflow/task scheduling beyond data sync+transform (e.g. arbitrary job DAGs), and independent corroboration of schedule reliability (community notes occasional sync drift requiring re-sync).
